               <milestone unit="section" n="v. 5"/> <lg><l>de dag rjes <lb n="1b4"/> zhugs dpyad la ltos myed par ||</l> <l>rnam 'jig sdud dang gzhung don gsal byed pas ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3773">ston de</rs>'i dgongs pa bde blag nges 'gyur ba'i ||</l> <l><rs type="work" ref="db:4550" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">legs bshad bsdus pa'i ti ka</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">bdag</rs> gis bya ||</l></lg><note type="translation">Without relying on the analyses of these followers,
By including criticism of them and clarifying the meaning of the treatise,
I will compose a commentary that is an Eloquent Summary 
Easily confirming the intentions of the teacher (Dharmakīrti).</note></seg></TEI>
